new_attributes.name: Turning circle between kerbs
new_attributes.description: Minimum turning-circle diameter explicitly measured between kerbs; distinct from wheel-track and unspecified turning-circle observations.

new_attributes.name: Turning circle by wheel track
new_attributes.description: Minimum turning-circle diameter explicitly stated using the wheel-track basis; distinct from between-kerbs and unspecified observations.

new_attributes.name: Maximum kerb weight
new_attributes.description: Maximum vehicle kerb weight explicitly qualified as maximum by the source; distinct from minimum and unqualified kerb-weight observations.

new_attributes.name: Payload
new_attributes.description: Source-stated payload observation. Exact values use the scalar table and bounded intervals use the range table; distinct from an explicitly stated maximum payload.

rules.decision: Basis-qualified turning diameters must use the matching dedicated attribute. New brochure evidence must not be stored in the legacy context-free turning_circle attribute.
Maximum kerb weight must not be folded into minimum_kerb_weight or unqualified kerb_weight.

A single source-stated payload uses configuration_attribute_values; a lower/upper payload interval uses configuration_attribute_value_ranges without flattening. maximum_payload remains reserved for an explicitly stated maximum.
Tyre, brake, suspension and steering specifications use existing string attributes and preserve the complete source wording rather than being decomposed without controlled dictionaries.
Model-wide or powertrain-wide chassis evidence is projected only when the source scope maps unambiguously to exact active configurations. Otherwise it remains deferred.
Physically implausible or duplicated mass-table labels are not semantically reassigned without corrected official evidence.
